name: Operations — Daily Rhythm (24h)
description: Standard 24-hour operational tempo template with daily battle rhythm: morning briefs, operational activity, reporting cycles, and end-of-day review. Use as a repeating daily pattern for sustained operations.

groups.name: Operations Centre
groups.description: Main operations hub — tracking, coordination, decisions

items.title: 0600 — Shift Change & Handover
items.description: Outgoing shift briefs incoming. Open incidents, pending tasks, key contacts.

items.title: 0630 — Morning Intelligence Brief
items.description: Intelligence cell delivers overnight threat picture and key developments.

items.title: 0700 — Daily Operations Brief (OPSBRF)
items.description: Full operations brief. Tasks for the day, resource allocation, risk assessment.

items.title: 0800 — Field Teams Deploy / Tasking Issued
items.description: Field elements receive daily tasking and deploy to objectives.

items.title: 0900 — Main Activity Window Begins
items.description: Core operational activity. Track all significant actions and decisions.

items.title: 1000 — Mid-Morning SITREP
items.description: Brief status update from all elements. Issues, resource requests, blockers.

items.title: 1200 — Noon SITREP & Logistics Check
items.description: Noon status report. Logistics reviews supplies, transport needs.

items.title: 1400 — Decision Point / Tasking Review
items.description: Review ongoing tasks. Reallocate resources if needed. Approve new tasks.

items.title: 1600 — Afternoon SITREP
items.description: End-of-activity-window status report. All elements report current status.

items.title: 1700 — End of Main Activity Window
items.description: Core operational activity concludes. Remaining tasks handed to overnight watch.

items.title: 1800 — Daily Summary Report
items.description: Full daily summary: tasks completed, incidents, issues, next-day priorities.

items.title: 1900 — Intelligence Wrap-Up
items.description: Intelligence cell daily wrap. Updated threat picture for overnight / next day.

items.title: 2000 — Evening Shift Handover
items.description: Day shift hands over to night watch. Open items, on-call contacts, alerts.

items.title: 2200 — Night Watch Check-In
items.description: Night watch confirms all systems nominal. Escalation procedures reviewed.
